improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating Gideon's value proposition and low entry barrier. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial and starting price builds trust and sets expectations without requiring invented claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for business owners and trade professionals. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clarifies its core function (AI trade and business assistant), building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while targeting the specific audience. Ending with the free trial offer and 'no card required' reduces friction and encourages immediate engagement. Copy stays factual, professional, and conversion-focused without invented claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join GDN AI as a member. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing and save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point—the paywall after the free trial. By clearly explaining what happens next and immediately reinforcing value and affordable pricing, it reduces uncertainty, builds trust, and nudges visitors toward conversion before they encounter the paywall unprepared.
